_doc: data/protocol_phase1.json — the ONE $0 first step per root cause, SELECTED from that root cause's
own authored text, plus a build gate that keeps the selection honest.
WHY IT EXISTS. Measured hydrated at 390x844 in the DEFAULT DOM state (nothing clicked, nothing
expanded) on all 52 /protocol/* routes before this file:
· "Phase 1" / "Phase 2" anywhere on the page:                0 of 52
· "$0" / "zero-cost" anywhere on the page:                   1 of 52
· any instruction to hold everything else constant:          0 of 52
· the ⭐ keystone card — the page's OWN free single habit, whose authored rationale says
"need no gym" and "they're free" — at median y 17,687 px on a median 18,939 px page
(94% depth) on 52 of 52, and 7,732 px BELOW the page's first supplement link (median
y 9,698 px, 54% depth) on 52 of 52.
The cheapest thing on the page was the last thing on the page.
THIS FILE WRITES NO CLINICAL CONTENT. Every `action` is a condensation of a `quote` that is a
VERBATIM substring of one of three authored sources on that root cause's own page:
from="keystone"      data/keystones.json[<rootCauseId>].one
from="prescription"  clinical_graph root_cause.prescription.detail
from="fix"           a fix on that root cause's MAPPED cause (data/cause_map.json) whose
kind is "behavior". Compound, food and rx fixes are refused.
assertPhase1() in build/parse.js rejects any action that is not verbatim-sourced, that uses a word
its own quote does not contain, that joins two interventions, that names a purchase, a
prescription, a dose or any compound the corpus knows, or that runs over 72 characters.
34 OF THE 52 AUTHORED KEYSTONES ARE NOT A VALID PHASE 1 AS WRITTEN — they name two or three
interventions ("A daily step floor plus protein at each meal"), a purchase ("5–10 g of soluble
fibre daily (oats or a psyllium scoop)") or a prescription ("Minoxidil or finasteride every single
day"). That is why this is a gated SELECTION and not a rename of the keystone field.
44 root causes carry a genuine $0 one-intervention Phase 1. The other 8 map to null and carry a
stated reason in `noZeroCost`, which the page prints. Inventing a free lever for
hair-loss/dht-sensitivity (finasteride and minoxidil) would be fabrication; saying "this protocol
has no free first step" is the honest answer and it is the one the page gives.
Shape: map["<problemId>/<rootCauseId>"] = { action, quote, from, fix?, class, cost } | null
action  the one imperative printed big. <=72 chars, no list conjunction, every non-function word
must appear in `quote`.
quote   verbatim substring of the source named by `from`, printed under the action so the reader
sees the authored sentence and not only the condensation.
class   movement | timing | light | sleep | breath | removal | food-swap | measurement | rest
cost    the literal "none".
WHAT THE GATE DOES NOT PROVE. It proves a Phase 1 is free, non-prescription, names no compound the
corpus knows, is verbatim-sourced and invents no word. It cannot prove SEMANTICALLY that a phrase
hides only one intervention — no lexical rule can. The rendered-page half of that claim is
assertProtocolSpine() in build/prerender.js, which requires exactly one .p1-action element per page.
Nothing in this file was reviewed by a clinician or any other authoritative professional, and
nothing in it may be presented as reviewed by a person. It is an editorial selection over an
authored text corpus.

noZeroCost.chronic-fatigue/iron-anemia: Every authored intervention here is a purchase or a lab test: check ferritin, take iron, pair it with vitamin C, time it away from coffee. The one free fragment ("avoid coffee/tea with iron meals") only exists as a modifier of the iron you have to buy.
noZeroCost.thyroid/subclinical-hypothyroid: The authored protocol is a prescription and a blood test — confirm TSH with a doctor, thyroid medication, iodine/selenium/zinc sufficiency. The one behaviour fix (a gluten trial) is conditioned on an antibody result.
noZeroCost.low-testosterone/primary-hypogonadism: This root cause is the confirmed clinical one. Its authored protocol is TRT or enclomiphene with physician workup and monitoring bloods, and no behaviour fix is authored on its mapped cause.
noZeroCost.skin-aging/uv-oxidative: This is the one root cause of 52 with no movement prescription authored at all, and every authored intervention is a product to buy: broad-spectrum SPF, reapplied, plus topical vitamin C.
noZeroCost.hair-loss/dht-sensitivity: The authored protocol is finasteride and minoxidil. The only behaviour fix authored is "Start early", which is a timing observation, not something a reader can do for seven days.
noZeroCost.hair-loss/nutrient-deficiency-hair: The authored protocol is a ferritin test plus protein, iron and zinc repletion. No behaviour fix is authored on its mapped cause.
noZeroCost.immunity/micronutrient-immune: The authored protocol is micronutrient sufficiency — vitamin D, zinc, vitamin C at onset. The only free items ("Sleep", "moderate exercise") appear as bare two-word list entries with no dose, cadence or target, so promoting one would mean writing the protocol rather than selecting from it.
noZeroCost.pre-workout/low-readiness: The authored protocol is stimulant and carbohydrate timing — caffeine 3–6 mg/kg pre-session, citrulline for pump. The only free fragment ("ensure sleep/hydration underlie it") is a bare list item with no dose or cadence.
